seoDescription: Your rooms are already deciding how you live. Petrina Salema helps change what they decide, for homes and guest stays in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

statement.hook: Your rooms are already deciding how you live.
statement.support: I help people change what the rooms decide, for themselves and for their guests.

proof.lede: One Vienna home, tested on paying guests for five years.

invite.hook: Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose.
invite.body: A few homes and hospitality spaces a year. Most take one to three months, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.
